proposal.description: The OVERCURRENT bit is not recorded while an OVP is inferred, on the belief that a window trip during an analog overvoltage is only a consequence of the overshoot
proposal.reason: Suppose the converter is in S_SS or S_RUN, latch_state is set with latch_assert clear (OVP inferred), and window_trip or window_trip_SS fires on the same clock. fault_reg then reads only the OVP bit, where it should read OVP and OVERCURRENT.

proposal.description: UVLO is not recorded while the protection latch reads back set, on the belief that an input droop after a latch trip is caused by the trip
proposal.reason: Suppose uvlo_state asserts while the converter is in S_SS or S_RUN and the debounced latch readback is set, from either an OVP or a CPLD trip. The UVLO bit is then never set in fault_reg, though the other cause bits are still recorded.
